# Close wrap — Fri 2026-11-27 (half day, 1:00 PM ET close)

**Indexes:** S&P 500 +1.60% to 7,297.49, Dow +1.18% to 50,774.94, Nasdaq +2.31% to 24,129.50 ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/26/stock-market-today-live-updates.html), [AP](https://apnews.com/article/wall-street-stocks-dow-nasdaq-04dab6079cf7f3dfe7285a3cc1f240a2)). Week: S&P +5.6% (best since Apr 2025), Dow +5.5%, Nasdaq +6.7% ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/wall-street-stocks-dow-nasdaq-04dab6079cf7f3dfe7285a3cc1f240a2)).

**Why:** bargain-hunting in battered AI names after an "oversold" week; Huang's return as NVDA CEO and Anthropic's dip below its IPO price drove the swings ([Reuters/Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/wall-st-futures-surge-as-investors-return-from-holiday-5053052)).

**Sectors/covered:** semis index +4.7%, MU +7.6%, MRVL +7.3%, NVDA only +0.8% ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/news/sp-500-caps-best-week-in-over-a-year/)); META >+3%, AMZN ~+4%, AVGO ~+4%, Anthropic ~+11% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/26/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)). BTC back near $62k ([X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2125837114394960106)).

**After hours:** no notable earnings (holiday half day).

**Setup:** Goldman sees CTAs/systematic funds selling up to $100B more next week; VIX ~24 ([X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2126285338809401673)). Chicago PMI Mon, ISM Mfg Tue, CRM Wed AMC, NFP Fri; Dec 9 FOMC hike ~fully priced. AI-hardware group avoid reviewed at Mon 11/30 close.

## Ideas
No new swing calls: session-after-shock-bounce rally into a thin half day with heavy systematic selling flagged (lessons 11/06, 10/23). Existing holds unchanged.
